name: Fix Authentication Token Rotation Bug
description: Refresh token reuse is allowed because old tokens are never invalidated after use
prompt: Fix the bug in src/TokenService.js where refresh token reuse is still allowed. When a refresh token is used, it must be removed from the valid tokens set and a new one issued. The old token must be invalidated.
acceptance: Old refresh token is invalidated after use
New refresh token is issued on successful refresh
